text: This level tells how God tested Abraham by asking him to offer his son Isaac (Genesis 22:1-19).
It follows the Bible's words, gently. The hardest moment is shown only as words on a dark screen. Isaac is never shown on the altar, and he is never hurt.
The level centers on Abraham's trust that "God Himself will provide the lamb," and on God stopping him and providing a ram instead. It then points to Jesus, "the Lamb of God."
You may want to play it together and talk about it afterward.
The device hums. Beersheba, early in the morning: a feathery tamarisk tree, a deep well and Abraham's tents. Isaac is a boy now, old enough to carry a load.
Some time later God tested Abraham and said to him, “Abraham!” “Here I am,” he answered.
